subject.title: fix: cron main-session wakes skipped as disabled without per-agent heartbeat config [AI-assisted]

question: Should cron-owned main-session systemEvent wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat scheduler omission when global heartbeats are enabled, and should this branch be the canonical landing path?
rationale: The bug is source-visible, but the fix direction changes explicit per-agent heartbeat omission semantics and overlaps with several open candidate PRs.

options.title: Accept Cron Override After Full Fix
options.body: Require the queued scheduler-path repair and live cron proof, then accept cron scheduling as authoritative for main-session systemEvent wakes while the global disable gate remains authoritative.

options.title: Keep Per-Agent Omission Authoritative
options.body: Reject this bypass direction and keep the canonical issue open for an implementation that does not wake agents omitted from heartbeat config.

options.title: Pick A Different Canonical Branch
options.body: Pause this PR if a sibling branch will carry the full reviewed fix for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Cron Override After Full Fix
recommendation.body: Require the queued scheduler-path repair and live cron proof, then accept cron scheduling as authoritative for main-session systemEvent wakes while the global disable gate remains authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent history signal on both the heartbeat scheduler state and cron timer decision surface.
